这是合成数学示例：曲线与表格使用完全相同的 9 个采样点，拖动“参数 a”后仅在本地重算 `y = sin(a·x)`；采样覆盖 `[-2, 2]` 全部区间，若出现定义域错误会保留为 `null` 缺口。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[aInput,chart,table], gap="medium")
$a: number = 1
let points = @sample(x => @sin($a * x), -2, 2, 9)
aInput = Slider(label="参数 a", bind=$a, min=-4, max=4, step=0.1, digits=1)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], unit="u", title="合成数学示例：y = sin(a·x)")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x","digits":2},{"key":"y","label":"y = sin(a·x)","digits":3}])
```
